title: This 3-Pound Desert Fox Has Ears Half as Long as Its Body

scenes.text: This desert fox weighs about three pounds, but its ears can be half as long as its body.
They're four to six inches long, the biggest for body size of any member of the dog family.
Job one is listening. The fox hears prey moving underground, then digs it out with all four feet.
Job two is cooling. In Sahara heat, those ears release extra body heat.
And it barely needs to drink, since it gets most of its water from food. One pair of ears, three survival tricks.
